On Thu, Nov 10,2022 at 8:24PM [opaque block] wrote:
Johnny, Vera,
Good morning. I'm writing to introduce you to David Agranovich, Meta's Director for Global Threat Disruption. David
shared an interesting perspective this morning on likely trends in tech company funding to fact checking and civil
society orgs around the world this morning. This has strong implications for your organization's goals and funding
plans, so wanted to connect you.

David,
Johnny is Deputy Assistant Administrator at USAID where he oversees the Center for Democracy, Human Rights, and
Governance in the Bureau for Development, Democracy, and Innovation (DDI). Vera Zakem is Senior Advisor for Tech
